// RED fixture for `no-raw-publish` — the KNOWLEDGE slice (KN-P06 / P-296). The lint MUST reject this.
//
// Knowledge emits its `knowledge.*` events via the transactional OUTBOX ONLY (architecture 03 §4,
// contract 2.2): every state change emits iff committed, in the SAME transaction as the state write.
// A write path that fire-and-forget-publishes the event directly onto the broker bypasses the outbox
// — the silent-data-loss / causality-break bug class (KN-D7): the event silently never lands, or
// lands without its block/row commit (a ghost). This is exactly what the no-raw-publish lint forbids.
pub async fn write_block(broker: &Broker, change: &KnowledgeChange) -> Result<(), Error> {
    let draft = knowledge_event_for(change);
    // BUG: a raw broker publish bypasses OutboxTx::emit — no same-transaction co-commit (KN-D7 hole).
    broker.publish("knowledge.block.updated", draft).await?;
    Ok(())
}
